scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix functions && npm ci --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix functions && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix functions && npm test --prefix apps/web
scripts.e2e: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.35.0 emulators:exec --project demo-calendar-sync --only auth,firestore "bash apps/web/scripts/e2e.sh"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix functions && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.emulators: npm run build --prefix functions && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.35.0 emulators:start --project demo-calendar-sync
